about: Golden vectors of the 21C per-key proof contract (decided 2026-09-26). Made ONCE with 21st Capital's key tooling and NEVER regenerated; the same file is copied unchanged into the backend and Talia. Test values only: labelled test keys, made-up seeds, placeholder xpubs.
check_order: key fields -> PROOF_KEY_SHAPE, or PROOF_NETWORK when the origin path is on another chain
proof object: exactly format, manifest, signature, index, path; the format; the types (manifest and signature strings, index an integer, path a list) -> PROOF_FORMAT
purpose -> PROOF_PURPOSE, chain -> PROOF_NETWORK, seed -> PROOF_SEED
at most 32 lowercase 64-hex hashes, inclusion under the root (RFC 9162 2.1.3.2) -> PROOF_PATH
signature recovers a key (base64, 65 bytes, header 27-42, 0 < r,s < n, low S) -> PROOF_SIGNATURE
no usable pin for (network, purpose, seed): absent, or not a P2PKH address of the network (surrounding spaces trimmed) -> unpinned
P2PKH address of the compressed recovered key differs from the pin -> PROOF_WRONG_KEY
